azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ighfir lahu warhamhu, wa afihi wa'fu anhu
azkar.translation: O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, grant him well-being, and pardon him.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ighfir lahu warhamhu, wa afihi wa'fu anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqayta ath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa abdilhu daran khayran min darihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi, wa adkhilhul-jannah, wa a'idhhu min adhabi al-qabri wa min adhabi an-nar
azkar.translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, grant him well-being and pardon him. Honor his place of arrival and make his entrance spacious. Wash him with water, snow, and hail, and cleanse him of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. Give him a home better than his home, a family better than his family, and a spouse better than his spouse. Admit him into Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave and the punishment of the Fire.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ighfir lahu warhamhu, wa afihi wa'fu anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad
azkar.translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, grant him well-being and pardon him. Honor his place of arrival, make his entrance spacious, and wash him with water, snow, and hail.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلَانَ بْنَ فُلَانٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inna fulana ibn fulan fi dhimmatik, wa habli jiwari-k, faqihi min fitnatil-qabri wa adhabi an-nar, wa anta ahlul-wafa'i wal-haqq, faghfir lahu warhamhu, innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim
azkar.translation: O Allah, surely [so-and-so, son of so-and-so] is under Your protection and within the security of Your covenant. Protect him from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the Fire. You are the One worthy of fulfilling promises and upholding truth, so forgive him and have mercy on him. Indeed, You are the Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ighfir lahu warhamhu, wa afihi wa'fu anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi mudkhalahu, wa adkhilhul-jannah, wa a'idhhu min adhabi al-qabri wa adhabi an-nar
azkar.translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, grant him well-being and pardon him. Honor his place of arrival, make his entrance spacious, admit him into Paradise, and protect him from the punishment of the grave and the punishment of the Fire.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ighfir lahu warhamhu, wa afihi wa'fu anhu
azkar.translation: O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, grant him well-being, and pardon him.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ighsilhu bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqayta ath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas
azkar.translation: O Allah, wash him with water, snow, and hail, and cleanse him of sins as You cleanse a white garment of dirt.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma abdilhu daran khayran min darihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi
azkar.translation: O Allah, give him a home better than his home, a family better than his family, and a spouse better than his spouse.

azkar.text: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
azkar.transliteration: rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan, wa fil-akhirati hasanatan, wa qina adhaban-nar
azkar.translation: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ قَبْرَهُ رَوْضَةً مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ حُفْرَةً مِنْ حُفَرِ النَّارِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma aj'al qabrahu rawdatan min riyadil-jannah, wa la taj'alhu hufratan min hufarin-nar
azkar.translation: O Allah, make his grave a garden from the gardens of Paradise, and do not make it a pit from the pits of the Fire.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ عِنْدَ السُّؤَالِ، وَثَبِّتْهُ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma thabbit-hu indas-su'al, wa thabbit-hu alal-iman
azkar.translation: O Allah, keep him steadfast when questioned, and keep him steadfast upon faith.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلَا تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهُ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu, wa la taftinna ba'dahu, waghfir lana wa lahu
azkar.translation: O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, do not test us after him, and forgive us and him.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ رَحْمَةً وَاسِعَةً، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُ ذُنُوبَهُ، وَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma irhamhu rahmatan wasi'ah, waghfir lahu dhunubahu, wa tajawaz an sayyi'atih
azkar.translation: O Allah, have vast mercy upon him, forgive his sins, and overlook his shortcomings.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ عِنْدَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ، وَثَبِّتْهُ بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma thabbit-hu indal-mas'alah, wa thabbit-hu bil-qawli ath-thabit
azkar.translation: O Allah, keep him steadfast when questioned, and make him firm with the steadfast word.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ وَسِّعْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِيهِ مُدَّ بَصَرِهِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma wassi' lahu fi qabrihi, wa nawwir lahu fihi, wafsah lahu fihi mudda basarihi
azkar.translation: O Allah, make his grave spacious, fill it with light, and make it extend as far as his sight can reach.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma innahu fi dhimmatik, faghfir lahu warhamhu, innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim
azkar.translation: O Allah, he is under Your protection, so forgive him and have mercy on him. Indeed, You are the Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

azkar.text: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
azkar.transliteration: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un, allahumma'jurni fi musibati, wa akhlif li khayran minha
azkar.translation: Indeed, we belong to Allah and to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ighfir li-hayyina wa mayyitina, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dhakarina wa unthana
azkar.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present among us and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu, wa la tudillana ba'dahu, waghfir lana wa lahu
azkar.translation: O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, do not let us go astray after him, and forgive us and him.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُ، وَأَسْكِنْهُ فَسِيحَ جِنَانِكَ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma irhamhu waghfir lahu, wa askinhu fasiha jinanik, wa akrim nuzulahu
azkar.translation: O Allah, have mercy on him and forgive him, grant him a place in the spacious gardens of Paradise, and honor his place of arrival.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلَانَ بْنَ فُلَانٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ فِتْنَةَ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابَ النَّارِ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inna fulana ibn fulan fi dhimmatik, wa habli jiwarik, faqihi fitnatal-qabri wa adhaban-nar, faghfir lahu warhamhu, innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim
azkar.translation: O Allah, surely [so-and-so, son of so-and-so] is under Your protection and within the security of Your covenant. Protect him from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the Fire. Forgive him and have mercy on him. Indeed, You are the Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ وَسِّعْ لَهُ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma wassi' lahu mudkhalahu, wa wassi' lahu fi qabrihi, wa nawwir lahu fihi
azkar.translation: O Allah, make his entrance spacious, make his grave spacious, and fill it with light.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، وَحَسُنَ أُولَئِكَ رَفِيقًا
azkar.transliteration: allahumma aj'alhu ma'a an-nabiyyina was-siddiqina wash-shuhada'i was-salihin, wa hasuna ula'ika rafiqa
azkar.translation: O Allah, place him among the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous. What excellent companions they are.

azkar.text: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً، وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
azkar.transliteration: rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan, wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada
azkar.translation: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and guide us to what is right in our affairs.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ، وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ، الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ighfir lana wa lahu, wa lijami'il-muslimina wal-muslimat, al-ahya'i minhum wal-amwat
azkar.translation: O Allah, forgive us, him, and all Muslim men and women, those who are living and those who have passed away.
